common.login_demo_hint: Click to quick-fill Grid Operator credentials
common.login_error_invalid: Invalid email or password (Password must be at least 8 characters)
common.station_modal_nearest_desc: Specify coordinates to find the nearest solar farm based on the Backend Haversine equation:
common.lb_desc: Record real GHI values to help retrain the LSTM model
common.lb_mae: MAE of the blend vs real
common.lb_time_note: Times are Thailand time (UTC+7) in 10-minute slots. File timestamps are rounded down to the slot (12:15 becomes 12:10).
common.lb_table_hint: The input starts with the forecast (or the saved label). Editing a value ticks the row. Only ticked rows are saved.
common.lb_confirm_all_hint: Ticks every unlabeled row so the forecast is saved as the real value. Use only if the forecasts match the real readings.
common.lb_invalid_values: {n} ticked rows have a value outside 0 - {max} W/m2 and will be skipped.
common.lb_no_points: No forecasts, weather data or labels for this day
common.lb_no_runs: No forecast runs for this station on this day, so the inputs are empty. Type the measured values or upload a file.
common.lb_file_hint: Only rows on {date} are imported. Pick the time column and the GHI column (guessed for you). Times without timezone are treated as Thailand time. Duplicate slots keep the highest ID.
common.lb_label_error: Cannot read labels from Label Studio
common.lb_login_required: Not signed in, or the session has expired
common.data_source_banner_desc: The model has not produced a forecast for this station yet
common.map_pick_hint: Click the map or drag the pin to set the station location.
common.admin_only: This page is for administrators (role: admin) only
common.ptarget_edit_hint: Edit this station's target and press Enter; the next forecast run uses it
common.ptarget_readonly_hint: This station's target is set by an administrator
common.no_forecast_desc: The model has not produced a forecast for this station yet. A new one is made every 10 minutes once the weather data is complete.
common.no_station: No station in the system yet
common.alerts_none: No station needs attention right now
common.ghi_note_blend: The blend trusts the satellite {pct}% at the first step, less later
common.ghi_note_lstm_only: No usable satellite image, so the blend equals the LSTM
common.sat_ok: Real satellite frames; the newest is {minutes} min older than the weather data
common.sat_shifted: Some frames were missing, so an earlier set is used ({minutes} min older than the weather data)
common.sat_missing: No usable satellite image; the LSTM is used alone
common.sat_night: Night: a visible-light image cannot show the clouds
common.sat_low_sun: The sun is too low for the image to show the clouds; the LSTM is used alone
common.sat_model_unavailable: The image model could not be loaded; the LSTM is used alone
common.sat_image_alt: Himawari satellite image around the station
common.sat_image_none: No satellite image for this station yet
common.aoi_caption: White box = the 5×5 px area (about 78×55 km) used for the cloud cover
common.rule_matrix_title: Decision rules (the highlighted cell is the situation now)
common.rule_note_now: Result now: {level}. The cloud level is the highest in the next hour.
common.rule_note_night: At night there is no solar generation, so this table is not used and it is not an alert
common.rule_note_no_satellite: No cloud information from the satellite, treated as uncertain: a shortfall gets an extra buffer
common.help_desc: What the abbreviations, alert levels and cloud levels mean
common.help_ghi: Global horizontal irradiance in W/m²: the higher it is, the more the panels generate
common.help_pgen: Forecast power = panel area × efficiency × GHI ÷ 1000 (kW), from the GHI that blends the LSTM with the satellite
common.help_ptarget: The power the station must deliver (kW), set by an administrator
common.help_dp: The largest amount by which P_gen is below P_target in the next 3 hours (kW); 0 when the target is met throughout
common.help_reserve: Reserve to hold = ΔP plus a buffer for the model's forecast error
common.help_lstm: Model that forecasts GHI 3 hours ahead from the recent weather data
common.help_convlstm: Model that predicts the next 18 satellite frames, used to measure cloud cover around the station
common.help_ghi_blend: Blend = LSTM weighted with the satellite result. The satellite weighs more at short lead times (about 80% at 10 min, 50% at 1 hour) and less later.
common.help_cloud: Cloud cover = cloudy pixels ÷ all pixels in the 5×5 px box around the station (about 78×55 km)
common.help_alert_night: The sun is down, there is no generation; not an alert
common.help_alert_normal: The target is met for 3 hours and the cloud impact is low
common.help_alert_watch: The target is met but the cloud impact is medium: keep watching
common.help_alert_warning: Power will fall below the target, or the target is met but the cloud impact is high: prepare reserve
common.help_alert_critical: Power will fall below the target and the cloud impact is high: dispatch reserve now
common.help_cloud_method: Thresholds from Kasten–Czeplak (1980): GHI ÷ clear-sky GHI = 1 − 0.75 × (cloud cover)^3.4, starting values to be calibrated with measured data
common.login_feat_lstm_desc: LSTM model, every 10 minutes, from recent weather data
common.login_feat_cloud_desc: ConvLSTM forecasts the cloud cover in the area around the station
common.login_feat_dss_desc: Compares generation with the target (ΔP) and recommends a reserve
